sleep_trails.settings.effect.tooltip: Smooths the sky while you sleep and, with Smooth Time Jumps enabled, when server time jumps between day and night. Gameplay follows the server immediately. A change applies from the next transition.
sleep_trails.settings.time_jumps.tooltip: While you are awake, smooths day-to-night and night-to-day jumps over five seconds, including other players skipping the night and matching time commands. Requires Sky Transition. A change applies from the next transition.
sleep_trails.settings.trails.tooltip: During a transition, visible stars draw long-exposure trails with vanilla rendering or the supported shader setup. Off, the sky still runs on. A change applies from the next transition.
sleep_trails.settings.camera.vanilla.too: Vanilla's bed view, tilted up toward the sky by the Tilt below. Third person stays vanilla.
sleep_trails.settings.camera.cinematic.t: The view slowly rises toward the sky. In third person (F5), the camera circles the bed to a wide shot of the trails, and eases back after you wake.
sleep_trails.settings.tilt.tooltip: How far Vanilla mode turns the bed view up toward the sky. The default, 0° (Vanilla), leaves its angle unchanged. Auto follows your field of view, so the bottom of the screen sits just below the horizon.
sleep_trails.settings.eye_position.vanil: Vanilla's eye point. With an animated player model, a worn helmet can cover the sky.
sleep_trails.settings.eye_position.towar: 0.4 blocks toward the foot of the bed, so a worn helmet stays out of the sky.
sleep_trails.settings.eye_position.raise: 0.3 blocks higher, so a worn helmet stays out of the sky.
sleep_trails.settings.eye_position.vanil: Vanilla's eye point, with your own sleeping body drawn in the vanilla pose while you look from it. Needs Entity Model Features.
